valores.label: funnel-web deaths in the review, all before antivenom

fonte: Isbister et al., Medical Journal of Australia, 2005
texto_para_tela: AT LEAST 13 DEATHS BEFORE 1981 · 1981 · ANTIVENOM · NO CONFIRMED DEATH SINCE · 97% (28 OF 29)
credito_sugerido: Source: Isbister et al., Medical Journal of Australia, 2005
nota: 'The 77 cases comprised: 13 deaths (all before the introduction of antivenom in 1981)'; 'Funnel-web spider antivenom was first used in 1981'; 'We found no confirmed deaths after funnel-web spider bite since the antivenom was introduced'; '28 of 29 patients (97%)'. O 97 % é de 29 casos: '28 OF 29' ao lado é mais honesto. DIVERGÊNCIA DE DATA na régua dos soros: Winkel 2006 diz 'culminating, in 1980, with the release of the funnel web spider antivenom'; Isbister 2005, 'first used in 1981'. A voz diz 'That year [1981], an antivenom came into use': fiel a Isbister. Na régua, '1981 · FIRST USED', nunca '1980' ao lado sem dizer que é o lançamento.

grafias_do_espelho: AT LEAST 13 DEATHS BEFORE 1981 (na folha do canal, sem o texto do MJA: r2, DF-06)
Source: Isbister et al., Medical Journal of Australia, 2005
NENHUM TRECHO DO MJA COMO TEXTO
NUNCA 'NO ONE HAS DIED FROM A SPIDER BITE SINCE 1981'
texto_aprovado: For a long time, those bites could kill. Before 1981, funnel-web spiders killed at least 13 people, by one review of the recorded cases. That year, an antivenom came into use. The review found no confirmed death after it. Where an expert had identified the spider, the antivenom worked completely in almost every case.
